# Supper Club Project

## Setup checklist

- [x] Verified this workspace instruction file exists.
- [x] Confirmed requirements: React food-delivery ordering experience.
- [x] Scaffolded the project with Vite and React.
- [x] Built restaurant discovery, filtering, bag, and checkout flow.
- [x] Required extensions: none specified.
- [x] Built and linted the project successfully.
- [x] Created and ran VS Code build and lint tasks.
- [x] Launched the development server after confirmation.
- [x] Updated project documentation.

## Project details

- React 19 with Vite; JavaScript and CSS.
- Default delivery area: Khammam, Telangana. Other locations are in Telangana and nearby Andhra Pradesh.
- Search, cuisine filters, rating/price sorting, item quantities, and a sample checkout flow.
- Prices use INR. Start with `npm run dev`; verify with `npm run build` and `npm run lint`.
- Checkout is a front-end demo. Restaurant data is sample data; food photos load from Unsplash.

Keep changes focused, preserve responsive behavior, and validate ordering interactions when changing this project.
